scope: Controlled same-album research evaluation. The correction stage sees the varied album and one intended reference per lighting group. Clean counterparts and injected settings are reserved for this evaluator. The intended normalization baseline is the same matcher run on the unperturbed album, so these scores establish stability against injected global tone/color variation, not an independent judgment of ideal normalization. Targets then use the independent Pillow style editor. Style weights are fitted only on representatives. Metrics cover decoded full-resolution JPEG exports sampled at the stated evaluation size. Original scenes, styles and algorithm were developed on this album; this is not unseen-album or human-edit validation. Local relighting, clipped-detail recovery and mask quality are outside this test.
